webSocketConnect-url.label: Address
webSocketConnect-url.tip: WebSocket server URL, auto-prefixes ws:// (or wss:// if starts with s+)

webSocketConnect-onOpen.label: OnOpen
webSocketConnect-onOpen.tip: callback when connection opens, @event represents the event object

webSocketConnect-onMessage.label: OnMessage
webSocketConnect-onMessage.tip: callback when message received, @event.data contains the data

webSocketConnect-onError.label: OnError
webSocketConnect-onError.tip: callback on connection error, @event represents the event object

webSocketConnect-onClose.label: OnClose
webSocketConnect-onClose.tip: callback when connection closes, @event represents the close event
